title: Delta-driven benchmark archive and triage orchestration for p95 regressions
creator: Ava Kline
description: Build an end-to-end flow that archives benchmark runs as compact delta artifacts, surfaces meaningful diffs in a comparison UI, and orchestrates an anomaly triage workflow for p95 and tokens/sec regressions. This ticket covers the storage schema, delta encoding strategy, comparison UI UX for pinpointing root causes (kernel/quantization/seq-length buckets), and the automated triage plumbing (rerun, alert, assign). The goal is to reduce signal-to-noise for oncall/bench squads and speed up time-to-resolution for performance regressions impacting production inference costs and p95 SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Compact archived artifact format defined and implemented (<=20% size of full raw traces for typical runs)
Comparison UI shows side-by-side per-run p50/p95/tokens_sec and a delta waterfall by contributing factors
Automatic regression detector flags a run when delta_p95 > 10% AND delta_tokens_sec < -5% or similar policy; alerts create triage cards
Rerun orchestration can replay a flagged benchmark against pinned commit + last-known-good and store both artifacts
Oncall triage flow produces a pre-filled triage card with suggested root-cause buckets and links to relevant PRs/bench jobs
Performance metadata (model id, quantization profile, kernel variant, seq-length histogram) is searchable in the benchmark catalog
comments: 2025-01-16 - Kickoff: scoped to storage schema + detector logic + UI mockups. WIll partner with console team for UX hooks. Diego to prototype compact delta encoder.

2025-01-21 - Prototype update: delta encoder that stores per-token micro-latencies + seq-length bucket summaries reduces size by ~68% on sample runs. Tradeoff: loses raw trace ordering; we keep optional raw snapshot for one run per day.
2025-01-28 - Engineering review: agreed to a two-tier retention policy (delta artifacts 90d, raw traces 7d). Security asked for KMS tagging on archived artifacts — added to scope.

2025-01-30 - UX sync with Console: comparison UI will include an expand/collapse waterfall and a small flamegraph-like view for kernel hot spots. Console will expose an API to surface triage cards in the rollout page.

2025-02-02 - Detector tuning experiment: initial rule (delta_p95 > 10%) produced too many false positives for short sequences. Updated detector to be sequence-length aware and use z-score over rolling baseline. Reduced false positives by ~55% in validation set.

2025-02-04 - Integration test: rerun orchestration successfully replayed 3 flagged benchmarks against specified commit hashes and attached artifacts to the triage card. Next: add GitHub PR auto-linking when rerun commit matches a recent PR author.

2025-02-05 - Blocker discovered: some GPU driver telemetry missing from nightly runs, which impairs kernel-level attribution. Created follow-up ENG ticket (ENG-27423) to fix telemetry ingestion pipeline. Partial workaround: fall back to host-level metrics for attribution in UI.
next_steps: Finish KMS tagging integration with storage team (blocked by ENG-27423 telemetry fix)
Implement UI server endpoints to fetch delta artifacts and compute waterfall on demand
Add contributor attribution (kernel/module/quantization) into delta encoding metadata
Ship v1 alerting rule to bench-oncall with clear triage instructions and rollback playbook
